component.name: Mie Survival
component.summary: Voxel survival sandbox with crafting, hunger and multiplayer

description.p: Mie Survival is a lightweight voxel sandbox focused on gathering resources, crafting, exploration, building and survival. This Linux package includes persistent worlds, server-authoritative multiplayer, farming, cooking, equipment progression, base sieges and low-end graphics defaults.
Network recovery, packet validation, chunk streaming and low-end renderer stabilization without new content.
Stability, incremental view-distance application and Minecraft-compatible skin system.
Input, camera, timing and persistence hardening for the v0.9 stabilization cycle.
Gameplay, networking, save durability and low-end performance stabilization without new content.
Data-integrity hotfix for transactional sidecars, persistent entity IDs and authoritative item drops.
Server action validation, network synchronization fixes and Survival or Creative world creation.
Gameplay and performance stabilization for hashing, worker waits and authoritative knockback.
Home, farming, cooking, repair and world-backup survival systems.
First Flatpak-ready Linux build based on Survival v0.1.
